Name: HealthEnergy
Author: slpOff
Description:
[b]HealthEnergy[/b] combines your health and energy into one shared bar.

Taking damage and using energy both reduce the same pool. Restoring health or energy adds to it, so keep an eye on your bar whether you're farming or exploring the mines!

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Health and energy share one combined pool.[/*]
[*]The energy bar displays your remaining shared pool.[/*]
[*]Damage and energy use draw from the same bar.[/*]
[*]Run out of the shared pool and you'll pass out.[/*]
[*]Enable or disable the mod with Generic Mod Config Menu, if installed.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract HealthEnergy into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
